notes.title: Story Patch
notes.content:
This is our first patch after attending Nordic Game Conference! We've gotten some great feedback, that inspired this first set of targeted improvements and fixes. Next we'll tweak the dialogues more, fix issues and add content! Thank you for playing!

Story
Added several key NPC that will play a role moving forward:
• John - An adventurer who thinks the treasure might be the cause behind creatures acting oddly
• Gavin - The  leader of the adventurers, with his eyes set on the treasure
• Erwyn - The awoken who left the notes in the tutorial, who holds some answers

Also added some story drops:
• A dead awoken who left a note with directions to Erwyn
• Another Ancient Tablet holding ancient lore to be found in Gouraija Forest

General Gameplay
• Slowmo when menu opened and interacting
• Limited your movement right before gaining an ability to stop you from movement dashing away

Miscellaneous
• Increased UI size by 15% on Steamdeck to make text easier to read
• Improved insert gem tutorial
• Added RT attack input preset

Bugfixes
• Fixed flickering barrels / crates
• Fixed intercept double charging
